raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

This PR follows #PR1, which adds Intel GPU (XPU) support. Some existing FSDP tests still skip or fail on Intel GPUs because they use CUDA-specific device checks, tensor placement, or the NCCL backend.

This change makes those tests use AReaL's selected platform:

- `tests/test_fsdp_grad.py`: use `current_platform.device_type` for accelerator tensors and skip accelerator-dependent tests when the selected platform is CPU. This covers gradient norms, gradient clipping, and consistency between CPU-offload and accelerator paths.
- `tests/torchrun/run_fsdp_optimizer_dtype.py`: initialize the process group with `current_platform.communication_backend` instead of hardcoded NCCL.
- `tests/test_train_engine.py`: check that `eval_batch` returns a tensor on the selected platform's device type instead of requiring `is_cuda`.

This PR changes only tests and test helpers. On CUDA, the tests run the same checks with the same numerical tolerances, while the affected tests can now also run on XPU.

## Related Issue
Depends on #1832 ; please merge that PR first.

## Type of Change

<!-- Select ONE that best describes this PR -->

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [x] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

<!-- Mark with 'x' what you've done -->

- [x] I have read the
  [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [ ] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):**

N/A

## Additional Context

### Validation

Tested on one Intel Arc Pro B70 with torch 2.13.0+xpu and transformers 5.17.0. Passing tests before (#1832  only) → after:

| Test file | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FSDP gradients (`tests/test_fsdp_grad.py`) | 18 / 29 | 29 / 29 |
| Training engine (`tests/test_train_engine.py`) | 24 / 27 | 26 / 27 |
| FSDP optimizer dtype (`tests/test_fsdp_optimizer_dtype.py`) | 0 / 3 | 1 / 3 |

The remaining tests require multiple GPUs. Multi-GPU XPU execution was not validated, and the four-GPU train-engine test still has a CUDA-specific skip condition.
